title: Streamline failure safety controls
summary: Streamline routine failure notice lifecycle, evidence archive, and policy cleanup confirmations while preserving strict media, source, pending publish, and selected-path delete safety gates.
reason: Operators were forced through preview/fingerprint and repeated guardrail text for low-risk notice and evidence workflows that the backend can safely recompute at apply time.
behavior_before: Failure lifecycle, routine evidence archive, and policy cleanup apply paths required prior dry-run fingerprints and repeated WebView guardrail text even when no media files were touched.
behavior_after: Routine failure lifecycle, active evidence archive, and policy cleanup can apply against the current backend-computed plan without a fingerprint; supplied fingerprints still reject mismatches, selected artifact paths still require fingerprints, and media/pending-publish gates remain unchanged.

py_compile failure backend and contracts - passed
python -m unittest requested failure/report target set - passed (123 tests)
python -m unittest targeted failure/report/contract/webview suite - passed (147 tests)
rollback_plan: Revert the failure facade/service, WebView Reports, route contract, documentation, tests, generated summaries, and this change packet to restore preview/fingerprint requirements for these routine failure workflows.
